name: Trees and Hypercubes Are Incomparable
scope: Finite connected graphs, including the zero-dimensional and one-dimensional cases in their intersection.
statement: Neither the class of finite trees nor the class of finite hypercubes contains the other.
proof: The path $P_3$ is a tree but is not a hypercube. The square $C_4=Q_2$ is a hypercube but is not a tree.
